_about: The open-weight leaderboard models that fit on RobertsPC (two RTX 4060 8 GB = 16 GB, llama.cpp splits the layers), served by LM Studio over LM Link at localhost:1234 on the Mac. Files and precision are Robert's picks of 2026-10-20: Qwen3.5-9B stays Q4_K_M (the file of every earlier local run), Qwen3.5-4B BF16 (the board row's precision), Gemma 4 12B Q8_0 (Robert 2026-10-27, in place of the Q6_K pick: it is the file on the PC); gpt-oss-20b left out. These are new board rows (GGUF on llama.cpp, LM Studio's tool parsing), not replacements of the bf16 vLLM rows. lms_key is the LM Studio model key; `lms load` over LM Link takes only the bare key and loads the variant selected on the PC, so lms_campaign.py refuses to start unless that variant and the loaded quantization are the ones named here. Sampling (extra_body) is the Runpod rows' (benchmarks/runpod/models.json). measured = lms_campaign.py check: one ~29k-token prompt at context 65536. The five entries from devstral-small-2 on (2026-10-27) are the smoke candidates of PLAN.md step 5, not board rows yet. vision = whether LM Studio lists the file as taking images (lms ls --json, 2026-10-27); vision_check = lms_campaign.py vision: one lettered image through the harness's route, read or not, and what it cost in prompt tokens. context (2026-10-28, Robert: run at the highest context that fits; a model without enough context for these tasks leaves the list) = the window the model loads at, found by lms_campaign.py fit (LADDER 131072, 114688, 98304, 81920, 65536; ceiling CONTEXT, floor FLOOR_CONTEXT 65536 = the hosted rows' window); fit = that walk's record; dropped = the model did not load at the floor and is off the local list until fit takes it again.

qwen3.5-4b.download: on the PC: lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF --select  (pick BF16)
qwen3.5-4b.notes: Same attention layout as the 9B (8 full-attention layers of 32, 4 KV heads), so ~4 GB of context at 65k on top of 8.4 GB of weights. lms_key and variant are filled in once the file is on the PC (`status` lists the candidates).

gemma-4-12b.name: Gemma 4 12B (Q8_0, LM Studio)
gemma-4-12b.label: gemma-4-12b-q8-lms
gemma-4-12b.notes: Robert, 2026-10-27: run the Q8_0 already on the PC instead of downloading the Q6_K (his 2026-10-20 pick). The Q8_0 would not load at 65k with --gpu max (failed to allocate compute pp buffers); LM Studio's auto split ran 1,140 tok/s prefill, 12.8 tok/s gen. At 131k more of it sits on the CPU: `check` records what it does. LM Studio thinks by default for Gemma 4 (397 of 400 tokens were reasoning in the Q8 test); Gemma writes little per episode (1.8k out tokens on Runpod), so 12 tok/s is workable.
